listing.name: Armored Core: Master of Arena / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Choose the official v0.1.0 ZIP for your system and extract it to a writable folder. Choose the Intel or Apple silicon archive that matches your Mac.

steps.title: Install the build tools
steps.instruction: On Windows, install Python 3 and follow the wizard’s portable build-tool instructions. On Linux and Mac, put a native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. On Mac, install Xcode Command Line Tools.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Use the two USA discs in order, SLUS-01030 and SLUS-01081. In the upstream launcher’s Disc Selection, use Browse For Disc to assign every image to its numbered slot before starting setup with Disc 1. Supply your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Use the matching CHD or keep the CUE and every referenced BIN together.

steps.title: Build and add the player
steps.instruction: From the kit folder, run Armored_Core_Master_of_Arena (with .exe on Windows) and choose Generate & rebuild. In Portcove, select build-release/Armored_Core_Master_of_Arena (with .exe on Windows) and use build-release as the start folder. Save the details, then choose Play.

warnings: Portcove has not verified native setup, gameplay or save compatibility for this kit.
The v0.1.0 kit can assign the discs during setup. Its game configuration says switching discs during play is unimplemented.

references.title: Linux and Mac compatibility
references.instruction: The Linux setup host requires glibc 2.29 or newer, libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.26, OpenGL and zlib. The Mac host and bundled generators require macOS 11 or newer.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep the complete working folder and back up your disc images, BIOS, saves, settings and mods. Use the upstream setup kit when replacing your player.
